selectionPolicy.note: Hypertokens are low-specificity implementation fragments in @layer hypertokens; component rules in assets/base.css are unlayered and therefore authoritative. A fragment that restates a base.css rule can never win, so it is duplication rather than a source of truth. Only fragments that add a property base.css does not set belong here. Component and layout selection narrows by shape, then intention, in specs/content-map.md.
